summary: Verify that selected finishes are visibly distinguishable under repeatable viewing conditions.
objective: A viewer can distinguish the intended material roles without relying on labels alone.
example_prompts: Verify that selected finishes are visibly distinguishable under repeatable viewing conditions.

principles: Judge materials on the target object and a simple reference sample; geometry can hide or exaggerate a finish.
Keep a written distinction between authored appearance, source-backed shader semantics and measured physical properties.
implementation: Save the light rig, environment, exposure and camera distance. Capture front and grazing views with a neutral reference.
Compare dielectric, bare metal and transmissive parts using the relevant material profiles. Change only one setting at a time.
Record unreadable reflections, lost silhouettes, transparency artifacts and scale-inconsistent texture detail with the view that reveals them.
observable_checks: A viewer can distinguish the intended material roles without relying on labels alone.
A repeated baseline produces the same visual comparison; inconclusive differences are reported as inconclusive.

known_limits: No universal roughness value or objective realism score is prescribed; art direction can deliberately simplify response.
Authored reusable guidance; no runtime artifact or improvement has been observed for this record.
creative_affordances: Adapt proportions, finish and presentation to the scene; explain deliberate departures from this guidance.
